Documents Suggest Chemical Weapons Used in Sudan Conflict

A trove of documents suggests the Sudanese military may have developed and used toxic bombs during the country's civil war. One text message sent to a military officer involved in airstrikes contained a video of an apparent victim with charred skin, accompanied by the words: "Your cooking." These documents bolster allegations that chemical weapons were used to gain an advantage in the conflict.
